decision: Reconfigure one live card and trigger both actual buttons; only the latest callbacks fire once and their contextual names change.
alternative: Replace the previous Open UIAction by identifier on each configure.
defect: Accumulating Open handlers dispatches obsolete callbacks.
gap: Check both buttons, contextual labels and the decorative star separately.

decision: Change the live amount and its layout, not payment control identity or payment policy.
defect: Rewired Pay, fixed height and shrinking text fail the contract; out-of-scope local stack fails compilation, not an assertion.
gap: Layout and callback contract, not delivered interaction.

decision: Preserve the native adjustable control and working two-way binding; require evidence for a claimed defect.
alternative: Leave implementation unchanged; document how the parent receives a one-point adjustment before recommending any alternate presentation. Do not invent a spoken result.
defect: Initialize local State once from the supplied volume so accessibility adjustments always have local storage.
gap: The edited control no longer writes the supplied parent binding.
reference: Keep the labelled Slider using the supplied two-way binding, 0 through 100, step 1. No defect is established.

decision: Preserve native toggle activation, label and persisted value.
method: Local written contrast against supplied Toggle
alternative: Leave the labeled Toggle forwarding the existing Binding; equivalent factoring must still write to the same owner.
defect: Replace the binding with private initial State; subsequent edits never reach the preference store.
gap: Source grading only, no runtime AX claim or invocation evidence.

decision: Evaluate the transaction in effect at the next change without resetting page state.
alternative: Trace a toggle while on Playback: stay there, then advance to Downloads under the new preference. No additional transaction or modifier is justified.
defect: Recreate the entire PageView with a new identity on each Reduce Motion change.
gap: A preference change resets selected page.
reference: Leave the view unchanged: the environment feeds the animation policy; the page state and wraparound button do not depend on it.

decision: Restore the prior accessibility setting only for the owning panel completion and resolve an eligible target or fallback then.
alternative: Restore the prior background value via a captured restoration closure.
defect: On ordinary finish force the background visible rather than restore its original state.
gap: Does not prove every stale-callback, fallback or teardown path.

decision: The installed shortcut on Open reaches current Save and declines when disabled; ordinary controls retain their own targets.
alternative: Use a UUID revision for the action registration.
defect: Press ordinary Save and verify it does not dispatch Open. This is narrower than the optional shortcut contract.
gap: Use AppKit getter/setter and installed handler APIs. Add a starter-compatible shortcut test; the ordinary Save check alone is insufficient.

decision: At completion resolve membership and eligibility in the originating window rather than using a process-wide most recent responder.
alternative: Use a per-document coordinator and resolve a stable field ID in that document at the current completion; ignore a stale inspector or an ineligible or reparented field.
defect: Use the last eligible text field seen anywhere in the application when any inspector closes.
gap: Closing A can redirect keyboard input to B.
reference: Store a weak origin per inspector presentation; on completion check current generation, field eligibility and membership in the same window before requesting focus.

decision: Both actions remain reachable with long text on the deployment target; tie any new API or system preference to verified availability.
alternative: Use an adaptive layout that places actions below long localized titles when horizontal space is insufficient. Preserve existing actions; isolate any later API behind its documented tvOS introduction.
defect: Keep the header on one line and replace the Details button with a hidden shortcut when German text grows.
reference: Move the title above a separate action row; let it wrap. Keep both Play and Details on the 26 target. Do not depend on newer facilities without a verified availability boundary.

decision: Distinguish executed state and action assertions from assistive speech or delivered focus; record SDK, target and runtime.
alternative: Keep separate build and unit receipts with the three version fields. Replay an unchanged failed input against the same assertion; report spoken output and rotor behavior as unmeasured.
defect: Reflect over the View tree after the units pass and certify the rotor order and spoken text from its internal labels.
gap: Reflection is not an observation of delivered accessibility behavior.
reference: Compile the modifier composition; unit-test state transitions and handler effects including defects. Preserve original source and diagnostics and record SDK, runtime and deployment target. Neither asserts speech or rotor behavior.

decision: Reject both cross-item and same-item superseded results while clearing optional state on rebind.
alternative: Request identity plus item identity or a per-configuration lifetime.
defect: Only checks file ID, allowing the earlier request for B to win.
gap: Need an integrated tvOS card with stale callbacks on two successive loads of the SAME file, optional help/status clearing, and surviving ordinary Open. Single-row status or item-only checks do not qualify it.

decision: Keep display clamping, terminal deduplication and stale-ID rejection independent.
alternative: Consume the active download ID at terminal delivery.
defect: Allow a second terminal event; expected one terminal announcement.
gap: Notification requests only, not spoken delivery.

decision: Place the shortcut on a reachable owner, validate current permission and preserve the independent ordinary actions.
alternative: Route both Delete entry points through the current command target with an expiring per-binding token and live permission check. Preserve Open; assert the actual deleted IDs after reuse.
defect: Install a closure once that deletes whichever file is currently in the row. Keep both buttons.
gap: A retained shortcut for A can delete B.
reference: Keep Open and Delete; bind a shortcut to this file and configuration. Recheck identity and enabled state on invocation. Test retained A after rebind, disabled B, current B and the ordinary paths.

decision: Read native characteristic and publish only for the live request; inspection performs no selection writes.
alternative: Cancel superseded work and validate an owner token at commit. Render pending/ready/error with ready carrying a possibly empty set. Compare selection before and after inspection; no inference of delivered narration.
defect: Temporarily select the descriptive audio to check it, then restore the prior option. Report nil when loading fails.
gap: Inspection writes selection and conflates a failure with absence.
reference: Model loading, available, absent and error separately. Inspect tagged options without selecting; accept completion only for the same item and current load. Test late success and failure and unchanged audio and captions.

decision: Reject duplicate IDs before mutation and retire removed child data; preserve surviving nodes and visible selection.
alternative: Use registry membership by object identity.
defect: Accept a detached node and serve its obsolete children.
gap: Not a full proof of preserved expansion/selection on a rendered outline.

decision: Retain an installed choice before reload; stale action cannot modify selection and current action still works.
alternative: One item write after resolving choice or Off.
defect: Fire old picker ownership against a replacement item and inspect the actual selection, not a menu ID.
gap: Related macOS request, not this full starter. Qualify lifetime across leaving/returning and retry before scoring the full workflow natively.

decision: Distinct missing item and empty group, reachable retry, mounted load and native selection read/write.
alternative: Resolve the optional native option first, then write selection once. This alternative varies selection wiring, not state classification.
defect: Missing item must differ from an inspected item without options. Mapping a nil item to absent fails.
gap: Require evidence for the playing item as well as distinct load states. Supply a working media fixture and separate state and selection scores; an absent fixture must not silently pass.

decision: Show active outside-list choice as distinct from Off; do not change selection for an unknown ID.
alternative: Resolve the optional choice before a single item.select call.
defect: Select a known caption and inspect native legible selection. A local-only update cannot pass.
gap: Trace a real legible selection, preserve audio and distinguish unlisted from Off. Make the native group/option fixture available under the supplied starter interface.

decision: Former same-item binding cannot alter the native legible group, but the current binding can.
alternative: Resolve choice and Off before the common native write.
defect: Reload on the same item; a superseded picker request must not apply its choice.
gap: Probe both item identity and request generation. Fire the old Off after replacement or same-item reload, then a current choice. Assert the native selection on both paths.
